record.statement: Prove a quenched invariance principle for simple random walk on the random interlacement set and on an infinite component of the vacant set of random interlacements.
record.status_search: Procaccia, Rosenthal and Sapozhnikov (PTRF 2016) proved a quenched invariance principle for random walk on the interlacement set for every u > 0 and on the vacant set for u small; combined with the 2023 sharpness result of Duminil-Copin, Goswami, Rodriguez, Severo and Teixeira (which gives the required decoupling and local uniqueness for all u < u*), the vacant-set case throughout the supercritical phase appears to follow, but this combination was not verified in a fetched source. Admitted for the vacant set with u in the whole phase (0, u*) as the residual question.
record.title: Quenched invariance principle for random walk on the vacant set of random interlacements in the whole supercritical phase

record.author: claude-probability-1000-continue-0907
record.key_identity: QIP (PRS 2016) holds under decoupling + local uniqueness; DGRST 2023 supplies both for all u < u*.
record.method: Check the hypotheses of the Procaccia-Rosenthal-Sapozhnikov framework against the 2023 sharpness result.
record.obstruction: Exact matching of the hypotheses not verified against fetched texts.
record.result: PRS prove the QIP for correlated percolation models satisfying a decoupling condition with polynomial error, a local uniqueness condition and a density condition; for the vacant set these were verified for u < u** (strongly supercritical) at the time. The 2023 sharpness theorem establishes u* = u** = bar u, so the local uniqueness and decoupling inputs hold for every u < u*, and the PRS conclusion should extend verbatim. The only step to check is that the constants in the PRS conditions are allowed to depend on u (they are), and that the decoupling inequalities used in the sharpness paper are of the form PRS assume (stretched-exponential in the scale with polynomial sprinkling), which they are by construction of the u** definition. So the vacant-set QIP for all u in (0, u*) is, to the best of this attempt, a corollary of PRS 2016 plus DGRST 2023; I could not fetch both sources in this session to confirm the exact form of the conditions, so this is recorded as a conditional resolution, not a promotion.
